subject.title: fix: let approval commands bypass active reply lane

question: Should text `/approve` be allowed to override `commands.text=false` on native-command surfaces, or must this PR preserve the existing text-command routing gate before bypassing the reply lane?
rationale: The submitted patch changes compatibility-sensitive command admission behavior; code can enforce the existing gate, but intentionally overriding it needs maintainer-owned product and upgrade direction.

options.title: Preserve the router gate
options.body: Require `/approve` bypass and fast-path logic to run only when the existing text-command router would handle the command, preserving current `commands.text=false` behavior.

options.title: Define an approve override
options.body: Allow `/approve` to ignore `commands.text=false`, but document and test that explicit exception through the handler and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the PR blocked until the contributor rebases and adds direct real-behavior proof from this branch.

recommendation.title: Preserve the router gate
recommendation.body: Require `/approve` bypass and fast-path logic to run only when the existing text-command router would handle the command, preserving current `commands.text=false` behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related merged approval-routing work and this extraction branch, so they are the best available owner for the approval-routing intent question.
